stories.text: T. C. Hine designed the Coppice Hospital, a hospital on the hill off Ransom Road, built in 1857–59. It closed in 1985,[^walk] and the building is now flats.

walk.title: Mapperley and St Ann's hills and hospitals walk (Nottingham City Council, 2021)

241777.sum: The Coppice Hospital was a mental health facility in Mapperley, Nottingham, England.

stories.text: St Jude's on Woodborough Road opened in 1877 on land given by the Wright family, as a daughter church of St Ann's. Its chancel came in 1893 and its aisles in 1916, and it became a parish of its own on 9 November 1926.

242175.sum: St Jude's Church is a parish church of the Church of England in Mapperley, Nottinghamshire.

stories.text: George Thomas Hine designed the Nottingham Borough Lunatic Asylum, opened in August 1880 with its wards along one long corridor. It was extended in 1889, joined the NHS as Mapperley Hospital in 1948, and closed in December 1994. The north end is now Duncan Macmillan House, the local NHS trust's headquarters, and the south end, Nightingale House, is flats.

242419.sum: Mapperley Hospital. Today it houses Duncan Macmillan House.
